question: What organization, member and case information may be sent to the external AI query service, who may ask it questions, and how is the answer it returns recorded and reviewed before it is relied on?
decision: External natural-language AI query is disabled at launch and no tenant data is sent to the provider. Any later enablement requires vendor/DPA and residency review, tenant permission, a data-minimization allow-list, redaction, purpose limitation, monitored outputs and a validated audit/retention policy. “Caller’s own org data” is not a sufficient permission to export case details.
originalProposedDecision: Disabled at launch. If enabled later: only aggregates and the caller's own org data, never member names or case text; every question and answer stored and marked 'AI-generated, not reviewed'.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
